def optimal_score(m, matrix):

    # Alice will always move down to the second row, then Bob will move right.
    # The optimal strategy for Bob is to collect the maximum coins in the cells he visits.
    
    # Calculate the prefix sums for both rows to quickly find the sum of coins Bob collects.
    prefix_sum_row1 = [0] * (m + 1)
    prefix_sum_row2 = [0] * (m + 1)

        prefix_sum_row1[j] = prefix_sum_row1[j - 1] + matrix[0][j - 1]
        prefix_sum_row2[j] = prefix_sum_row2[j - 1] + matrix[1][j - 1]
    
    # Bob's optimal score is the maximum difference between the prefix sums of the two rows
    # for any column position. This is because Bob can choose to start collecting coins
    # from either row at any point, and he will always choose the row with the higher prefix sum.
    max_difference = 0

        max_difference = max(max_difference, bob_coins_row1 - alice_coins, bob_coins_row2 - alice_coins)
    
    return max_difference
